case_title: Kanchan Sharma v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.306, s.3(2)(v) of the SC and ST Act
neutral_facts: The accused, a woman, was approached by the deceased, a man, who visited her house and consumed poison from a small bottle he carried in his pocket. The deceased was found unconscious and later died in the hospital. The deceased had previously called the accused and proposed marriage, threatening to die otherwise if she did not agree. The accused and her father had previously complained to the police about the deceased's behavior. The prosecution alleged that the accused abetted the deceased's suicide and committed casteist abuse. The court found no credible evidence linking the accused to the deceased's death, noting that the deceased's actions were his own and there was no active act or intent to instigate suicide.
